_about: Sources for the MapleStory Classic World plan. The updater reads this file each run. 'official' sources can create [V] facts; 'community' sources can only add [?] notes or review-queue leads. Times in Nexon's CMS liveDate are US Pacific wall-clock even though the string ends in 'Z'.
keywordFilter: Classic|MSCW|Founder|Closed Online Test|COT|Inkwell|Maple Memo|Exploration Report|Ossyria|Victoria Island|Leaf Points

sources.name: Nexon CMS news API (list)
sources.covers: Every Global MapleStory post, Classic World included: announcements, release/patch notes, maintenance (balance changes have appeared inside maintenance posts), known issues, sales, FAQ.
sources.howToSpotNew: WebFetch and ask for 'the first 25 items in array order exactly: id, name, category, liveDate (raw string), isMSCW'. New = id not in state.json seenIds. Edited = a seen id whose name changed ([Updated M/D], [Completed], [Sales Closed] prefix) or that jumped back to the top with a new liveDate. Relevant = isMSCW true OR keywordFilter match on name/summary. Never trust the summarizer's item counts or time conversions.
sources.notes: Query parameters are ignored. nexon.com news pages are JavaScript shells; cite posts as https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/{category}/{id}/{slug}.

sources.name: Nexon CMS news API (single post)
sources.covers: Full HTML body of one post.
sources.howToSpotNew: Fetched only for ids flagged by nexon_cms_list. No created/updated field exists. Some posts (Inkwell's Notes, Exploration Reports) are images or video only: flag those 'image-only: needs community transcription'.

watchedIds.43962: Aug 11 2026 maintenance with COT2 balance changes
watchedIds.45230: Maple Memo: sanctions apply across MapleStory and Classic (2026-09-22)

sources.name: Nexon news hub (human-facing)
sources.covers: Same posts as the CMS API. Use only for citation links and for the user to read.
sources.howToSpotNew: Use nexon_cms_list instead.

sources.name: Classic World home and Founder's Package page
sources.fetchable: no (JS shell); /mscw/pre-launch-sales returns only a headline
sources.covers: Landing page and package store.
sources.howToSpotNew: Not useful for diffs.

sources.name: Nexon support center: MapleStory Classic category (Zendesk API)
sources.fetchable: yes (the /hc HTML pages return 403; the API works)
sources.covers: Classic help articles. As of 2026-10-02 only the Founder's Packages FAQ (article 53268989017620, updated 2026-10-01).
sources.howToSpotNew: Act when 'count' changes or a new article id appears. Use created_at for 'new'; updated_at changes often without content changes.

sources.name: Nexon support center: article search
sources.covers: Any help article mentioning Classic World (noisy).
sources.howToSpotNew: New ids at the top.

sources.name: Support: What activities constitute User Abuse?
sources.covers: Botting/macro definition, hacking tools, gold trading (RMT), account trading and sharing bans.
sources.howToSpotNew: Re-read monthly; updated_at is noisy.

sources.covers: Links to Terms of Use, Code of Conduct, Terms of Sale. The ToU page itself (nexon.com/main/en/legal/tou) is a JS shell.
sources.howToSpotNew: updated_at (last 2026-07-16).

sources.name: Nexon Code of Conduct
sources.covers: Macros/botting, third-party programs, RMT, exploits (Nexon-wide, not Classic-specific).
sources.howToSpotNew: updated_at (last 2026-09-17).

sources.name: Steam news API for MapleStory (app 216150)
sources.covers: A subset of CMS posts mirrored by Nexon, with true Unix UTC timestamps.
sources.howToSpotNew: Sort by 'date'. Fallback if g.nexonstatic.com fails.

sources.name: YouTube @MapleStory (official) Atom feed
sources.fetchable: yes (feed only; channel page is not)
sources.covers: Trailers and recaps. Classic titles end '| Global MapleStory Classic World'.
sources.howToSpotNew: New <entry> with 'Classic World' in the title. Videos are leads; facts need text.

sources.name: Official X, Facebook, Discord, Reddit
sources.fetchable: no (X 402, Facebook login wall, Discord messages unreadable, reddit.com refused by WebFetch)
sources.covers: Announcements are mirrored on the CMS.
sources.howToSpotNew: Not usable by the updater.

sources.name: meowdb (NiaMeowDB) Classic news
sources.covers: Rewrites of official announcements, usually linking the Nexon post; transcribes image-only posts.
sources.howToSpotNew: Index is newest first with 'Mon DD, YYYY' dates; compare the top 5 slugs. No RSS. Rebranding to niadb.com in late Oct/early Nov 2026 (old links redirect).
sources.reliability: Medium-high secondary; fast. Not affiliated with Nexon.

sources.name: meowdb Classic sitemap
sources.covers: Every news and guide URL with lastmod.
sources.howToSpotNew: List /news/, /guides/ and /changelog URLs with lastmod >= last run date (date precision only).

sources.name: meowdb game-data changelog
sources.covers: Diff between datamined client snapshots (items, spawns, skills, scrolls, quests). Current snapshot header: 2026-08-04 (COT2).
sources.howToSpotNew: A new header date means a new client build was datamined (likely around Oct 6). Treat as a lead to re-check skill and item values.
sources.reliability: High for raw values; datamine of a test build.

sources.name: meowdb Classic database (items, monsters, maps, skills, classes, NPC shops, quests, crafting, Cash Shop)
sources.fetchable: yes (monster 'Mesos per kill' and 'Drops (MS Classic)' are community reports; 'MSEA reference drops' are legacy MapleSEA data, not Classic)
sources.covers: COT2 client datamine: skill values, mob level/HP/EXP/DEF/elements, spawns, NPC shop prices, Cash Shop catalog with 100 NX test placeholder prices.
sources.howToSpotNew: Watch meowdb_changelog rather than individual pages.

sources.name: meowdb guides (DPS rankings, damage formula, class guides, grind maps, Forgotten Hollow, KPQ, EXP table, spawn engine)
sources.covers: Models built on datamined values: /guides/class-dps-rankings (2026-09-28), /guides/explaining-the-damage-formula (2026-09-24), /guides/best-grind-maps-every-level (2026-09-23), /guides/exp-table-level-1-to-100 (2026-09-18), /guides/spawn-engine-respawn-and-map-capacity (2026-08-24), /guides/kerning-city-party-quest-kpq-guide (2026-08-12).
sources.howToSpotNew: Use meowdb_sitemap lastmod; each guide has an 'Updated YYYY-MM-DD' byline.
sources.reliability: Medium. Mixes datamined facts with inference; several are marked drafts.

sources.name: meowdb server status
sources.covers: Polls Nexon maintenance notices.
sources.howToSpotNew: Status text.

sources.name: meowdb community price board
sources.covers: Community-reported 14-day medians. Empty as of 2026-10-02.
sources.howToSpotNew: Reference only. Never import prices into the plan; the user logs their own observed prices.

sources.name: maplestory.io API: MCW/CBT2 (Classic COT2 client) and GMS/83 (legacy)
sources.fetchable: yes (large image payloads can truncate responses)
sources.covers: Second independent Classic datamine for skill values; GMS v83 data is the legacy [B] baseline (e.g. https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/83/job/skill/2201004).
sources.howToSpotNew: Static; watch for a new MCW version path (e.g. MCW/LIVE).
sources.reliability: High for raw values; agreed with meowdb on every magician skill checked.

sources.name: OSMS Data Explorer repo commit feed
sources.fetchable: yes (feed; the osmsdataexplorer.com site is a JS app)
sources.covers: Raw stat values datamined from the client.
sources.howToSpotNew: New commits 'deploy: sync from osms_extractor <timestamp>' may mean new client data. Lead only.

sources.howToSpotNew: https://mapleclassic.wiki/api.php?action=feedrecentchanges&feedformat=atom&days=7&limit=50 (mostly bot edits).

doNotUse: spam pages on hijacked domains (highaltitudescience, appcentric, ckcs.net, mambu PDFs, studyabroadfoundation PDFs)
Private-server sources: MapleLegends, MapleRoyals, MapleSaga, r/mapleservers, Artale and other MapleStory Worlds fan games
China Classic (Shengqu) rules and economy: a different operator; never apply to Global
toolLimits: WebFetch summarizer miscounts long JSON arrays and mislabels times; ask for explicit fields only.
WebFetch does not follow cross-host redirects (e.g. classic.maplestorywiki.net -> mapleclassic.wiki).
WebSearch has a per-session budget (hit 200/200 during Phase 1 research). Updater runs should be fetch-first: about 5 fetches and 0–2 searches.
postingCadence: Classic posts so far: weekdays only, 07:55–17:52 PT, clustered Tue/Wed afternoons. Main MapleStory: patch maintenance Wednesday (notice Tue ~11:00 PT), minor maintenance Thursday. Suggested runs: ~12:30 and ~19:00 PT (14:30 and 21:00 CT), plus extra runs after the 11:00 PT opens on Oct 6 and Oct 21.
